milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The iron_block pillar is at spawn-relative (5, 2, 4) — the vertical center of the 5-block-tall pillar (y=0 to y=4). Player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they found it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range along the path, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the pillar.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The lantern sits atop the 3-block fence post at spawn-relative (10, 3, 9). Player must navigate near it and face it. max_distance=16 is generous enough for visual confirmation from the cobblestone path, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is oriented toward the lantern.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The carved_pumpkin is placed on a hay_block at spawn-relative (16, 1, 14). Player must navigate near it and face it. max_distance=16 allows detection from the path, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the distinctive orange pumpkin face.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The pyramid is a 3-tier sandstone structure (base 5x5 at y=0, middle 3x3 at y=1, peak at y=2) with a gold_block cap at spawn-relative (23, 3, 21). Target is the gold cap — the most visible and distinctive part of the pyramid. max_distance=16 allows the player to spot it from the path approach, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is oriented toward the structure.
